items.title_orig: What other songs do you think Joel and Ellie played on the guitar?
items.article_text:
Hi all, this question is just because I'm curious about you guys opinion/ thoughts and because I started playing guitar because of this game. So in the 5 years that Ellie and Joel lived peacefully in Jackson we know that Joel teaches Ellie guitar. We are given 5 full song covers be it in game or in the trailers. Those being: 
  
Future Days - Pearl Jam (Joel) 
 
Through the Valley - Shawn James (Ellie) 
 
True Faith - New Order (Ellie)
 
Take on me - A-ha (Ellie)
 
Wayfaring Stranger - Johnny Cash (Ellie and Joel)
 
 Covers heard in game but not fully released:
  
Helpessly Hoping - David Crosby, Graham Nash en Stephen Stills (Joel)
 
Ecstacy - Crooked Stills (Ellie)
